So we need to test both branches: when jsonNodeReader is null and when not null. Also test behavior for different InputFormat values (presumably an enum). Need to simulate InputStream with JSON/YAML content. Also test exception propagation (IOException). Also test that correct mapper is used.

Cases: valid JSON content, valid YAML content, IOException thrown by underlying mapper.

Define input parameters: content InputStream, inputFormat. Expected: JsonNode result (we can mock). Description.

Case2: InputFormat.YAML, content valid YAML, expect jsonNode from yaml mapper.

Case3: IOException thrown by mapper.readTree, expect IOException.

Group: jsonNodeReader not null.

Case2: jsonNodeReader throws IOException.
